recovery_notes: F004 broad-Exception backstop fired during stage='post_iter'. The iter loop raised PatchCompletenessError after 2 audit envelope(s) landed; the last entry in ``audit_paths`` is the most recent successful write (e.g. the orphaned implementer envelope when stage==auditor). Use the recommended close-out command to clear breaker:no_progress and flip features.json.
